name: Can decorative wall molding increase my home's value?

mainEntity.name: Can decorative wall molding increase my home's value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, decorative wall molding can enhance a home's perceived value and aesthetic appeal, especially if it complements the existing architectural style and is installed professionally. It adds a touch of custom craftsmanship and can elevate the overall interior design. While it may not always provide a dollar-for-dollar return, it often contributes to a more polished and updated look that can be attractive to potential buyers. A well-executed molding project can be a distinguishing feature in areas like Southeast Boise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionally installed decorative wall molding can increase perceived home value and aesthetic appeal, contributing to a polished look.
